title: Ask HN: I have been unemployed for 2y. 15 years of experience, US. What to do?
author: LetThingsBeDiff
description: I'm Senior software engineer in the US (DMV area), with 15y of experience. Worked for Fortune 50+ company and bunch of mid-size companies. Been unemployed for 2y and can't find a job, within those 2 years, I pretty much spent my savings that I've saved through years, maybe have 4-5 months left to support my household.…
